fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable name for this wave template (e.g. 'Floor 1 — Runner Storm').

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier for this wave template.

fields.name: role
fields.title: Role
fields.description: Whether this is a normal swarm wave or a boss wave. Source WaveManager boss-wave detection.

fields.name: enemyMix
fields.title: Enemy mix
fields.description: The enemy types this wave spawns and how many of each. Source WaveManager._spawn_wave_enemies weighted rolls + per-wave count.

fields.name: enemyType
fields.title: Enemy type
fields.description: The enemy spawned for this slot. References the enemyType schema.

fields.name: count
fields.title: Count
fields.description: How many of this enemy type to spawn in the wave.

fields.name: spawnRing
fields.title: Spawn ring (m)
fields.description: Annulus around the player where wave enemies spawn. Min/max radii in metres.
